headline: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
summary: OpenAI will no longer use NDAs with public officials for data center projects. This follows strong voter opposition to data center expansion. Many projects faced scrutiny for relying on NDAs.

headline: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
summary: Airbnb plans to launch an AI travel agent by Q1 2027. The AI will assist users in planning and booking trips. This initiative was shared in their Q3 2026 earnings report.

headline: The New York Times is in talks to buy Letterboxd for around $330 million
summary: The New York Times Company is in exclusive talks to acquire Letterboxd. The social network for film lovers is valued around $330 million. Sony Pictures and A24 were also rumored to be interested.

headline: T-Mobile owner on Elon Musk launching a wireless carrier: 'Welcome to the party'
summary: T-Mobile's parent company CEO doubts SpaceX's Starlink Mobile can become a major US carrier. Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Höttges acknowledges Musk's ambition. He estimates a $200 billion cost for such a venture.

headline: Amazon's Black Friday Audible Deal Is Now Live: Pay $0.99 Per Month Plus Get $20 Credit
summary: Audible's Black Friday deal offers $0.99 per month. Subscribers also receive a $20 credit. The offer is open to all new and previous members, Prime or not.

headline: Amazon Reveals Free Uber Eats Delivery for Prime Members, Plus $20 Off Your First Two Orders
summary: Prime members now get free Uber Eats delivery. New users also receive $20 off their first two orders. This benefit enhances Prime membership perks.

headline: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves
summary: An animated John Wick prequel film is officially in development. Keanu Reeves will return to voice the iconic assassin. The movie explores John Wick's story before the first film's events.

headline: Spectrum Is Offering Free Internet Upgrades So People Can Download GTA 6 Faster
summary: Spectrum is offering free internet upgrades to customers. The upgrades aim to help users download GTA 6 faster. This promotion is available this month.

headline: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
summary: Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault. He is expected to receive a significant prison sentence. More rape allegations against him can now be reported.

headline: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
summary: Major tech stocks have experienced a significant plunge. US midterms results contribute to fears of an AI industry slowdown. Markets react to potential tougher scrutiny on data center construction.

headline: Met chief warns policing 'heading for failure' without reform
summary: Met Police chief Sir Mark Rowley warns policing faces failure without urgent reform. He states the current system struggles with modern, sophisticated criminals. Reform is crucial to address evolving crime challenges.

headline: Firms told to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
summary: Companies are now urged to publish salaries in job adverts. This comes ahead of a new law requiring salary transparency. The government believes it will aid jobseekers and combat pay discrimination.
